test.name: Use acquired locked Linux optional sharp binaries with offline lifecycle rebuild
test.run:
python3 - <<'SHARP'
import hashlib,json,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path('empireai-web');raw=(root/'package-lock.json').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='84f99595b7564d9196b0eeb25c054b290801bfe2e3a148f61ab2c9c2871d37b4'
lock=json.loads(raw)
for name,version in [('sharp','0.34.5'),('@img/sharp-linux-x64','0.34.5'),('@img/sharp-libvips-linux-x64','1.2.4')]:
 p=root/'node_modules'/name
 assert p.is_dir() and not p.is_symlink(),name
 assert json.loads((p/'package.json').read_text())['version']==version,name
 assert lock['packages']['node_modules/'+name]['version']==version,name
print('Exact Linux x64/glibc optional packages acquired under lock; no source compilation override')
SHARP
npm rebuild --offline --prefix empireai-web
node -e 'const sharp=require("./empireai-web/node_modules/sharp"); if(sharp.versions.sharp!=="0.34.5")process.exit(1); console.log(JSON.stringify({sharp:sharp.versions.sharp,vips:sharp.versions.vips}))'
